## Chapter Twenty

The Bunker



The ambulance descended through the darkness of the rural area in Northern Maryland some hours later the landscape was spotted with farms and small communities that could barely be called civilization. Finding a field, the Doc set down the vehicle and everyone began to unload their critical gear for the journey. Packs slung and cases carried the group set out in a line following a map that hadn’t been used in close to a century. The air was cold, and Lucas braced himself against the wind as it began to pick up in the early morning hours before the sun would come up and warm the air to a tolerable level. He missed the tactical suit, the BDU’s even though made for winter did not keep the cold from biting his skin.

Lucas let his thoughts wander as he put one foot in front of the other towards the legend of an ancient bunker that they might possibly be able to enter, that might possibly hold the salvation of their ability to continue to resist. Lucas shook his head talk about a hail Mary he thought. He had experienced a lot of death over the past two years, a lot of pain and a lot of betrayal. He felt lost and unsteady.

He agreed with the fight and this past month had cemented his resolve, this government treated its people like a commodity, expendable and unimportant and they need to be held accountable for their actions. But under all of that was a deep running hatred he could still see the unemotional face of Job telling him “it’s not personal, it’s just business” before pumping him full of rounds.

The government had people, weapons and technology on their side, they were a mammoth with unlimited resources and had just proven their ability to squash this well-organized resistance like a bug. But buried in the hopelessness of their cause was something important, something that Dyson had given him during his time in prison, the greatest gift of all knowledge. There were ways to beat sleeping giants, ways that small groups could persevere against impossible odds, and he would find a way, he would use that gift to take down those who believed they were untouchable. They needed to be taught fear and the more Lucas walked the more a plan began to form.

“Hold up” came a call from Sally in the front. “we are close” Lucas looked up and scanned the area, he could see nothing that would indicate anything other than woods surrounding them. “Let’s spread out, we need to find a hatch or door or hell anything” Sally bellowed, throwing his hands up in frustration. Lucas began walking out from the line, looking for any sign of civilization or once was civilization.

He stepped felt something different under his feet, as the sole of his shoe slid. Lucas picked up his foot and looked down at a mostly rusted sign with words barely recognizable “Government Property” was the first line in the sign. Lucas cocked his head. Could it be true, could there actually be something here that could help them, that could give them a place to launch operations he wondered, slowing his steps.

Shaking his head in frustration he could find nothing else, just a damn sign that could indicate anything had been here, it’s possible that whatever had been here, was long since destroyed. To his left he could see Rolle walking parallel to him both looking for any detail. He scanned the trees and the ground and then back towards Rolle, except he was no longer there. Lucas cocked his head What the hell he thought, stepping over towards where he had last seen Rolle. As he approached, he could hear moaning and stepped up his pace. “Rolle” he said in a low tone. As he stepped forward his foot almost slid off the edge of a hole in the ground, impossible to see until you were right upon it.

Lucas leaned over the edge and tried to peer into the darkness. Then he heard it, the low moaning. “Hey over here” he said motioning for the group to join him. As they rushed towards him Lucas made a stop motion to the group and then pointed at the hole. Everyone slowed down finally reaching the location. Sally looked down and then nodded towards Emma who took off her backpack, rummaging around until she pulled out a rope.

“Lucas, you go down we will lower you” Sally said, Tying the rope around himself as an anchor.

Nodding Lucas grabbed the other end of the rope and tied himself off. Emma tossed him a flashlight and Lucas caught it deftly. He leaned over the edge and shined the light down in the hole. It was about twenty feet down and he could see Rolle laying at the bottom, when the light shined over him, he raised his hands to block the light. Lucas sighed with relief, he was conscious and okay, and he related that to the group.

Lucas was lowered slowly into the hole, his feet slipping on the wet earth surrounding the pit as he went. It took a few moments and he was standing on the bottom, the dirt floor was soft, which probably saved Rolle major injury he thought. Even as he was descending his friend was already on his feet and aside from a slight limp, he looked okay.

Lucas untied himself and checked his friend over “you okay?” he asked concerned. Rolle nodded “just got the wind knocked out of me” he responded sheepishly. Shining the light, he could make out a tunnel leading off into the distance, it was covered with roots and vines, but it looked passible. Kneeling down he dug his hands into the dirt, feeling something hard about four inches down, pulling the dirt back he found a concrete bed. At some point he thought this had been a manmade tunnel. “There is a tunnel, we are going to check it out” he called up to the group. “Be careful and if you’re not back in fifteen we are coming down” Sally called down with a concerned look on his face. With Rolle following behind him Lucas began to push at vines and roots slowly making his way down the long tunnel. He fought against his own claustrophobic fear as the tunnel began narrow, the roots overtaking the passage causing the two men to turn to the side to get by. Lucas could feel the mud as it pushed against his shirt and the prickle of pain from the root ends as they dragged along the skin of his arms and neck.

After a moment the passage opened back up and terminated at a wall of roots and dirt. “Shit” Lucas whispered, surveying the passage. Maybe I went the wrong way he thought and looked back over his shoulder, but no it had terminated at the hole he had come down in, so why was a passage here that literally went nowhere.

He stood there for a few minutes shining the light on the wall, following the contour of the roots. “Do you have your big knife” he turned and asked Rolle. With a smile his friend pulled the large blade from a sheath on his belt. “never leave home without it” he said. Lucas began cutting at the roots and after twenty minutes he had removed a lot of the surface detritus, with a disgusted sigh he began to push his hand into the mud, wincing as he pushed further, it felt like code and squishy and did not give him a pleasant feeling. Then his fingers stopped, he pushed a little harder and it didn’t give. Lucas ran his fingers over it, it wasn’t rough, it wasn’t concrete, and it definitely wasn’t dirt. “Hey Help me” he called excited to Rolle as Lucas began to pull at the mud, pulling it off the wall, Rolle stepped up beside him and began to do the same. After a few moments he shined the flashlight and a rusting grey metal surface met the light. Lucas smiled “We need to get everyone down here; I think we found it.”

They took turns digging out the what turned out to be a reinforced hatch, but to his and the others surprised as They cleaned the walls around the door, they found it was an alcove with an old terminal on the wall. The terminal was junk, water and roots and mud for seventy years had taken its toll.

Lucas sat watching Emma pulling wires out of the small opening now that she had removed the old terminal panel. Each wire was checked and tagged. “How long is that going to take?” Lucas asked her frustration in his tone as he felt the wet, mud and cold compounding with the surrounding dampness of the mud filled tunnel. Emma smiled “Well there are fifty wires, most of them have are in rough condition, I need to identify them using the original manual for the panel’s manufacture as well as the status meter, once they are all identified then I can proceed. The good news is the power wire is still hot, so somehow this place still has power coming from somewhere.” She said, never taking her eyes off of the wires or the floating numbers over the scanner sitting in her lap.

“How is it there is power here?” Lucas wondered out loud getting at first only a shrug from the tech genius “Could be wired into a grid, could be solar, could be low drain from a battery system, who knows” she said, shrugging a second time “just glad it does, makes my job a little easier” she finished. He watched her for another hour as she methodically went back and forth with the wires and finally smiling, she turned to him “Eureka” she said. “Tell V to bring my tech pack” she called to him and Lucas walked back to the hole. “Hey V, Emma needs her tech pack” he called up the hole. Victoria looked down holding a black bag, she lowered it on the rope, Lucas grabbed it and carried it back to Emma who eagerly took it.

Pulling out a little box with banana clips and wires. Looking over her tags she gently attached clips and began plugging in wires into the little box. With a flick of a switch a menu hovered in the air, illuminating the room slightly. She began to tap at the air, going through screen after screen, then a two-dimensional black box appeared, Lucas took a closer look “What the hell is that?” he asked. Emma just smiled. “it’s called a terminal window, it’s very old school” she said and concentrated, pulling her fingers apart a holo keyboard appeared just below the window. With a few keystrokes’ information began to scroll on the terminal window. “Oh, hell yes” Emma said excitedly. “We found it”.

Lucas sat there after excitedly announcing up the hole that the bunker had been found. He had remained excited for the first few hours but now he just felt bored. The excitement and euphoria of finding the impossible had worn off. Emma had not moved from her position except to stretch her legs and then go back to work.

“What are you doing?” Lucas asked finally breaking his self-imposed silence, Emma’s face was hard in the light of the holo screen as she continued to tap away, reading the screen and tapping again. “This is a seventy year old system, that was proprietary, I need to find the system that runs the genetic lock before we can work on breaking it, this system handles security, the doors , surveillance, utilities, air and many other things, I am having to root around to find what I am looking for on this old ass two dimensional text screen” she answered , and Lucas could hear the frustration. He decided to leave her be and got up, walking down the hall he climbed the rope to find the rest of the group sitting around, as bored as he was.

“Anything exciting?” he asked sarcastically. Sally just groaned. “Rolle and V have been alternating perimeter walks to ensure we are alone, and Doctor Becky is enjoying herself annoying me” he said shooting the little doctor the evil eye. Betty returned the look and stuck her tongue at him. Lucas just shook his head “good to see the adults are in charge up here” he said sarcastically, getting a dirty look from both of them. Before Lucas could sit Victoria shot bolt upright “Holy shit you guys have to see this” she said and rose. Putting the holo viewer she had been using on the ground. With a motion of both her arms she widened the holo image making it almost life size. There standing next to two of the CEO’s one for Security and one for Finance was Job all three smiling like they were old friends, the caption read “New Intelligence Chief Appointed”. Lucas could feel the rage bubble up from deep within him. There was the man responsible for the Death of so many. “So, this was his reward for destroying us” Lucas said the anger resounding in his words.

They all stood staring at the image each caught in their own thoughts until finally Sally made a disgusted noise “Shut the fucking thing off, I can’t stand to look at him” he said and turned, walking a little way off from the group. Betty followed him and they stood whispering to each other. “I can’t believe that son of a bitch” Victoria said. Her cheeks were bright, and her eyes practically boiled with the vehemence coming off her.

Lucas shook his head, he didn’t feel like talking and walked the opposite way from Sally and Betty, away from the group. He stood there his eyes closed as the cold breeze lit across his face. He could feel the ache from his orbital socket as the muscles strained against his false eye. Tears welled up in his eyes as he clenched his fist, fighting the urge to explode, destroying whatever he could get his hands on.

He tried to control his breathing, he tried to relax his muscles all to no avail. The picture of that smug bastard standing there getting rewarded, standing on the bodies of innocents and friends tore him apart from the inside. He willed himself to keep control, tears streaming from his eyes, his hands shaking, it took ten very long minutes before he could unclench his fists and allow himself to breath normally.

He turned and went back to the group. Sally and Doc had returned as well, and Rolle had just entered the small camp. Victoria came to stand next to him, putting a cloth in his hand, surprised he looked down to see the white cloth turning red. Opening his palm he saw the gouges left by his nails , looking up into the knowing eyes of his friend he whispered “thank you”. Victoria just nodded and headed towards the hole. “Emma has reached the end of her software expertise, so I need to go down and take over” she said with forced cheer. Lucas watched her go saying a silent thank you as he looked at the cloth in his hand, crimson spreading across the white cloth.

He strolled back towards the impromptu camp, sitting next to Rolle as he settled in to eat something. Rolle gave him a sideways look and handed Lucas an energy bar and a bottle of water. He took it gratefully realizing he had not eaten that day. “What do you think is in there” Rolle asked nodding towards the hole. Lucas thought about it cocking his head as if to reflect on the possibilities. “Whatever is in there, will be enough” he simply said. Rolle regarded his friend thoughtfully and then nodded turning to look off into the distance “It’s going to have to be” he finished. Lucas nodded. Emma emerged from the hole stretching and groaning. “Hey, get some food” Lucas said, wagging a bottle of water at her. With a tired smile the small woman came and sat with the two of them. “thanks” she said downing half a bottle of water in an instant.

“How is it going?” Rolle asked Emma shrugged “Getting Closer, just some really really old code” she finished. “V will crack it” she said confidence in his voice.

They sat there eating quietly Lucas’s mind was still in turmoil, he could not get the picture of Job out of his mind, that bastard had been given the keys to the kingdom for killing a room full of people whose only crime was caring enough about others to help. They weren’t traitors, they helped people get out of the country when the country was trying to kill them or worse.

He was brought out of his thoughts as Victoria emerged from the hole. Covered in mud but her face was beaming “Lucas, I need your DNA” she said laughing and then descended again. Everyone perked up, could it be they were almost through was Lucas’s thought and he was sure the group shared it. Getting up he made his way down the ladder and through the passage that had been made wider by the group’s efforts.

Coming into the alcove he found Victoria standing over a series of boxes that had been wired into the door wires. She beckoned for him to come over. Once he joined her, she motioned for him to give her his hand and as he did, she pricked his finger in one quick motion causing Lucas to jump back with a hiss. “Don’t be a baby” she admonished turning back to the system and laying the bloody pin on a scanner surface. She studied the monitor, the scanner still lighting over the pin as it scanned his DNA multiple times. “Okay, since yours is not an exact match, I am running pieces of your DNA against the bunkers database, it’s kind of like password cracking, seventy years ago this would have been impossible, both because of the safeguards the program has in place and because the technology to analyze an reorder DNA sequence strains instantly would have required a lot more computing power then would fit in this hall.” She finished. Watching two separate floating screens. Lucas tried to follow what was going on, but it was happening too fast and the information made no sense to him.

He sat back getting his back comfortable and watching the screens gaining little information, but the light pulses were relaxing, like watching the fire in a fireplace to relax. He sat there drifting off and sometime later he awoke with a start as someone was shaking him. Looking up into Victoria’s forest green eyes he could see the sparkle of excitement and knew they were in.

He got up, wincing as a lance of pain shot through his back from sitting up against the cold wet wall for so long. “How long was I out?” he asked yawning. Victoria had turned back to the floating screen studying the readings “two hours, and we are in, just waiting for the final lock approval from the system and that door opens, go get the rest of group” she said breathlessly, and Lucas rushed to the holes entrance. With a shout he called everyone to the holes opening. “We are in, get down here” he called once he could see the shadow of their heads.

Within twenty minutes they had their bags lowered and were coming down into the hole. It was a tight fit with the whole group and Lucas jockeyed for position, he wanted to see what his blood had opened. He stood there next to Victoria as she crouched over the computer. Finally, with a yip of excitement she waved her hand punching a finger in the air that caused a series of clanking noises from the door as the heavy bolts retracted. The door stayed shut, however.

Lucas approached the large hatch and looked at it and then at Victoria, with a worried expression she studied the data on her screen and shaking her head she turned back to Lucas “It’s says its opened” she said and shrugged, but he could see the frustration in her face. “Someone hand me a pry bar, I think the door is just stuck” he said, hoping he was right.

A large metal pry bar was handed from Rolle in the rear and made its way along the line of people each one saying a small prayer that this worked.

Lucas took the bar and approaching the door began to shove the flat edge of the bar along the edge of the hatch, the first few times it slipped off without being able to gain a purchase. The last time he shoved with all his strength and a small edge of the bar entered into the jam between the old metal door and its frame. He carefully pulled, trying to open the door just a little to insert the bar further. After a few gentle pushes, the bar went in further, allowing him more purchase against the frame. Then once it had most of the flat side in between the frame and door, he pushed, he pushed with all his strength, his calves burned and he pushed harder, he could feel his muscles shaking as he tried to give even more strength to the action. Just as he was about to give up , a long screetching sound emmited from the door and it began to slowly slide towards him. He flipped the bar around, inserting the hooked end. “Grab my waist” he said to Sally who stood directly behind him. He heard the command repeated along the row and the human chain pulled on command. The door slowly moving outward “Pull harder” Lucas yelled, feeling the pressure of Sally’s arms bear hugging his midsection. Finally, the door swung, its ancient and rusted hinges protested as the heavy door made the final arc open revealing a small dark hallway with another door on the other end. Victoria grabbed the flashlight and poked her head in looking around “It’s an airlock, let me get setup and I will get this open” she said packing up her gear. It took her a few moments to setup , the panel in here was fully intact and now that she had been In the system and unlocked the command codes with Lucas’s DNA she was able to punch in the over-ride and they watched as the final door opened, and the lights began to come on both in the airlock and beyond.

Lucas stepped forward into a large atrium, the air smelled stale and dank, somewhere deep in the murk there was a light, shining though barely, probably emergency lighting Lucas thought, squinting his eyes and wrinkling his nose. He surveyed the large room, it looked almost like an incident center with a central glass table covered in an inch of dust, rooms lined the first and second floors along the outside of the room, for a moment Lucas had a shiver run through his back as he thought it looked a bit like prison. The group stepped in behind him. “We have a lot of work to do” Sally said shaking his head. Emma snatched the flashlight from Rolle “hey” he protested and got a raspberry for his protest. “Come on Lucas, let’s get the lights on” She said and began walking into the room. Lucas navigated the chairs that had been pushed out around the table and dutifully followed the young lady deeper into the facility.

Dust and Cobwebs greeted them the entire way. The one light turned out to be an exit sign still lit after seventy years. Lucas looked at the simple mechanism with awe. How had it survived that long he wondered? Passing it he followed Emma, she navigated the complex like a young child looking for treasure, every door open encouraged a gasp or squeal of delight.

Lucas just smiled enjoying her enjoyment. They came to a set of stairs Lucas took the light and the lead, leading her down three flights of stairs to what looked like a basement. The smell of old mold was worse down here and as he entered his foot slipped on the wet concrete floor.  Looking down he could see the mildew that covered the floor, his foot slips the only grey part of an otherwise green floor. “Looks like we have some cleaning to do” he said as Emma entered behind him “Point the light over there” she said pointing towards a large machine in the far corner. Lucas did and Emma squealed with delight. She crossed the floor as fast as she could looking more like a five-year-old on a frozen lake then an expert engineer. Smiling Lucas followed. Shining the light over the large machine which looked more like a car turned on its side then any type of building machine. “This looks, rough” Lucas said surveying the old machine. “This is a pre generation one cold fusion reactor, before they were implemented for general power use” Emma said breathlessly. “This is why the building still had power, it’s in standby mode, but emitting enough power to run some of the emergency equipment” she answered breathlessly putting down the tool bag she had strapped over her shoulder.

“This is straight R and D work, not a production model” she said awe in her voice as she began to look over the controls and monitor lights of the behemoth. “See those six cylinders” Emma said with a smile pointing to the six contoured metal bulges and Lucas nodded “Those are the reaction chambers. It’s a kind of nuclear reaction but at room temperature. Today’s units are a lot smaller and probably put out more juice, but if I guessed right this will be more than enough to power the complex” she finished. Her hands expertly began pushing buttons and turning dials. At one point she paused, looking at the monitors and then with a final series of turns the large machine whirred to life. The giant beast began growling lowly as lights began to turn on.

All through the basement bulbs came on and quickly cut out, a few exploded once power touched the ancient items for the first time in decades. Lucas shook his head “We should have anticipated that” he chided to no one in particular. Emma got up “Yeah its bound to happen” she began walking towards a large panel with even more dials Lucas was definitely out of his element and not wanting to ask stupid questions he decided to turn to ones he was still trying to wrap his head around. “So, how is it there is a reactor down here seventy years old but still the basic technology is in use today?” he wondered out loud. Emma turned and smiled. “Lucas, didn’t you cover this in school” she teased him. Then in a serious tone she explained, her eyes and hands never leaving the new monitoring panel.

“After the plague, a lot of technology stood still, the world reeled for decades as economies crashed and whole continents relocated to bring people closer, it took a long time to begin turning the wheels of progress again. Hell, most of the tech we use today was available in one form or another before the country fell” she finished. It was still hard to wrap your head around Lucas thought, watching her go over the dials and trying to make sense of the monitor gauges. After a while she declared success and the two went back upstairs, being mindful of the slippery floor.

Upstairs the others, now that the lights were on, were exploring the upper rooms as they spread out to learn more about the place that none of them thought actually existed. Victoria leaned over from the upper balcony “We have offices up here” she said with a smile. “I am going to find the medical bay” Doc said walking towards one of the halls. “Take a buddy, no one goes anywhere alone until we have checked the entire place” Sally said giving her a severe look. Doc turned and with a wry smile taunted “Yes Daddy” and grabbed Rolle by the collar. “Let’s go soldier boy” she said dragging the poor guy down the hall.

Lucas came over to his friend “What’s our play boss?” he asked Sally smiled at him. “I know your hurting and I know you want revenge, but we need to get our house in order, we are reeling and need to build up our core again, then we can look at making a plan, for now we need to find rooms to settle into and also start going over things like water, power and sewer to see what works” He stated Lucas nodded. “I can check the basement for a potable water system, I’ll take Emma again in case it needs fixing” Lucas responded getting a nod from Sally. “Sounds like a plan. I will take Victoria and find sleeping quarters for us all”.

With that the group went about their separate ways. “Really, back to the basement, what you don’t like me or something, its slimy down there” Emma almost pouted out the statement. Lucas laughed “No, but we need to make sure the basics are working, right” Slapping her on her back they went back towards the stairs and down to the lair of mildew.
